mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GAME_PICK ( PICK_ID , GAME_ID , GAME_PARTICIPANT_ID , BAG_INDEX ) VALUES ( SEQ_GAME_PICK.NEXTVAL , ( SELECT GAME_ID FROM GAME WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId} ) , ( SELECT GAME_PARTICIPANT_ID FROM GAME_PARTICIPANT WHERE PARTICIPANT_ID = #{participantId} ) , #{bagIndex} )
mapper.sql: G.STATUS , G.BAG_COUNT , G.TURN_SEQ , G.CURRENT_PARTICIPANT_ID , G.CONSECUTIVE_TIMEOUTS , CASE WHEN G.TURN_DEADLINE IS NULL THEN 'N' WHEN G.TURN_DEADLINE <= SYSTIMESTAMP THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IS_EXPIRED
mapper.select:

SELECT G.STATUS , G.BAG_COUNT , G.TURN_SEQ , G.CURRENT_PARTICIPANT_ID , CASE WHEN G.STATUS = 'FINISHED' THEN G.WINNING_INDEX END AS WINNING_INDEX , GREATEST(0, CEIL((CAST(G.TURN_DEADLINE AS DATE) - CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS DATE)) * 86400)) AS REMAINING_SECONDS , ( SELECT GP.PARTICIPANT_ID FROM GAME_PARTICIPANT GP WHERE GP.GAME_ID = G.GAME_ID AND GP.IS_WINNER = 'Y' ) AS WINNER_PARTICIPANT_ID FROM GAME G WHERE G.ROOM_ID = #{roomId}

SELECT P.PARTICIPANT_ID , P.NICKNAME , P.IS_HOST , GP.TURN_ORDER , CASE WHEN GP.LEFT_AT IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS IS_LEFT , GP.IS_WINNER FROM GAME_PARTICIPANT GP JOIN GAME G ON G.GAME_ID = GP.GAME_ID JOIN PARTICIPANT P ON P.PARTICIPANT_ID = GP.PARTICIPANT_ID WHERE G.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} ORDER BY GP.TURN_ORDER

SELECT GPK.BAG_INDEX , GP.PARTICIPANT_ID , CASE WHEN GPK.BAG_INDEX = G.WINNING_INDEX THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IS_WINNER FROM GAME_PICK GPK JOIN GAME G ON G.GAME_ID = GPK.GAME_ID JOIN GAME_PARTICIPANT GP ON GP.GAME_PARTICIPANT_ID = GPK.GAME_PARTICIPANT_ID WHERE G.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} ORDER BY GPK.BAG_INDEX
SELECT GP.PARTICIPANT_ID FROM GAME_PARTICIPANT GP JOIN GAME G ON G.GAME_ID = GP.GAME_ID WHERE G.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND GP.LEFT_AT IS NULL ORDER BY GP.TURN_ORDER

SELECT GP.GAME_PARTICIPANT_ID , GP.PARTICIPANT_ID , S.RESTAURANT_ID FROM GAME_PARTICIPANT GP JOIN GAME G ON G.GAME_ID = GP.GAME_ID LEFT JOIN SELECTION S ON S.PARTICIPANT_ID = GP.PARTICIPANT_ID WHERE G.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND GP.IS_WINNER = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE GAME SET TURN_SEQ = TURN_SEQ + 1 , CURRENT_PARTICIPANT_ID = #{nextParticipantId} , TURN_DEADLINE = SYSTIMESTAMP + NUMTODSINTERVAL(#{turnSeconds}, 'SECOND') , CONSECUTIVE_TIMEOUTS = 0 WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND STATUS = 'PLAYING' AND CURRENT_PARTICIPANT_ID = #{participantId} AND TURN_DEADLINE > SYSTIMESTAMP

UPDATE GAME SET TURN_SEQ = TURN_SEQ + 1 , CURRENT_PARTICIPANT_ID = #{nextParticipantId} , TURN_DEADLINE = SYSTIMESTAMP + NUMTODSINTERVAL(#{turnSeconds}, 'SECOND') , CONSECUTIVE_TIMEOUTS = CONSECUTIVE_TIMEOUTS + 1 WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND STATUS = 'PLAYING' AND TURN_SEQ = #{turnSeq} AND TURN_DEADLINE <= SYSTIMESTAMP

UPDATE GAME SET TURN_SEQ = TURN_SEQ + 1 , CURRENT_PARTICIPANT_ID = #{nextParticipantId} , TURN_DEADLINE = SYSTIMESTAMP + NUMTODSINTERVAL(#{turnSeconds}, 'SECOND') , CONSECUTIVE_TIMEOUTS = 0 WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND STATUS = 'PLAYING' AND CURRENT_PARTICIPANT_ID = #{participantId}

UPDATE GAME SET STATUS = 'FINISHED' , CURRENT_PARTICIPANT_ID = NULL , TURN_DEADLINE = NULL , FINISHED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND STATUS = 'PLAYING' AND WINNING_INDEX = #{bagIndex}
UPDATE GAME SET STATUS = 'ABORTED' , CURRENT_PARTICIPANT_ID = NULL , TURN_DEADLINE = NULL , FINISHED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND STATUS = 'PLAYING'
UPDATE GAME_PARTICIPANT SET IS_WINNER = 'Y' WHERE PARTICIPANT_ID = #{participantId}
UPDATE GAME_PARTICIPANT SET LEFT_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE PARTICIPANT_ID = #{participantId} AND LEFT_AT IS NULL
